text: From https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk, README frame flow: "offer … accept … lock … reveal", and "Both sides fold the same transcript into the same state… applyFrame(state, lockFrame, Date.now()).state; // → locked … applyFrame(state, revealFrame, Date.now()).state; // → claimed". SPEC.md §4 is cited for "the full state machine and its guards", but its text was not fetched, so I can only fold on what is visible. ⏎ Final status: accepted. ⏎ Rejected record: the "lock" frame (tclk-offers, 2026-09-04T20:49:34.388Z) is rejected by the fold because its contract reference does not match the contract it claims to lock — it carries "ref":"0x439d97c124255a5149e304d8689f0ebdf64528b4ca533e40ad31b85658668fc5" while both the accept frame and the reveal frame carry "contract":"0x60051379e98cb8530083906f536aa2ae985155b03c77adf3c84788ce6acf295c". A lock that does not name the contract cannot be applied to it, so the fold's state after the lock line remains "accepted". ⏎ Consequences: since the lock is rejected, the state never reaches "locked", so the "reveal" frame (mb-p-tclk-60051379e98cb853, 2026-09-04T20:49:54.388Z) is also not applicable — a reveal can only claim a locked contract. Note I cannot verify the reveal's secret hash against the accept's "statement":"0x14a1f22b5f8bd06c5904fafdb2def36667222a623baa554d6e454596fadea52f" (no hash function is available in the material), so the only checkable rejection ground is the state-transition guard. The fold's terminal state is therefore "accepted", with the lock frame as the first rejected record (wrong contract ref) and the reveal as a second non-applicable record (no valid lock precedes it). No offer expiry applies: reveal time 20:49:54Z is before expiresMs 1788555534388. ⏎ Rows used: offer (tclk-offers 20:48:54.388Z, id 0x695f…756f, lock "hash", rails ["paper"]); accept (tclk-offers 20:49:14.388Z, contract 0x6005…295c, ref 0x695f…756f, statement 0x14a1…a52f); lock (tclk-offers 20:49:34.388Z, ref 0x439d…8fc5 — mismatched); reveal (mb-p-tclk-60051379e98cb853 20:49:54.388Z, contract 0x6005…295c, secret 0xbb66…0ab2).
